kind.doc: A city relic is hosted in a Shrine, a world relic in a Chapel; a source drops one kind (relic-restoration.md §1, §2).

door.doc: Where its first fragment is found by play: a lair for a city relic (its prize, when claimed), or a world source — room, boss, portal, scouting.

activeManaCost.doc: The Mana a cast costs. On a city relic, what one activation in its Shrine costs (09-relics.md §2).

activeRadius.doc: How far the ability reaches at level 1, plus one ring for each of relics.artifactRadiusSteps passed. On a city relic, its Shrine aura: every cell this many from the Shrine (Chebyshev).
